cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 (2026-2027 academic year): in-state tuition $6,838, nonresident tuition $19,084, required fees $1,910, on-campus food and housing $18,554 (housing $12,034 + meal plan $6,520). G5 estimates for students living on campus: books and supplies $1,806, transportation $1,386, other expenses $3,968 (other costs shown = transportation + other). CDS H6: institutional scholarship or grant aid is not available to degree-seeking nonresidents.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class; the PDF's page headers still say 2024-2025). Totals are the sums of the male/female/unknown-sex rows in C1 (applicants 88,276, admits 40,105, enrolled 5,884). The residency rows sum to 40,105 admits and 5,884 enrolled, but only 88,224 applicants (52 fewer than the gender total). Enrolled by residency: 5,714 in-state, 67 out-of-state, 103 international. CSULB says it has a waiting list but the CDS prints no wait-list numbers. Test-blind (C8A: SAT/ACT not used), so no test scores or submit rates. Undergraduate enrollment is the B1 total of all undergraduates (36,056); the B2 degree-seeking total is 36,703. Nonresident undergraduates (B2) 882; 109 of the 5,884 first-year students. C7 marks printed in the CDS: rigor Not Considered and class rank Very Important; CSULB's own eligibility pages describe an index built from college-preparatory course grades and do not mention class rank, so these two marks may be transposed.
